tei:div.tei:p: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa/ drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma/ bla ma rgyal ba kun 'dus/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum/ kun bzang yab yum/ tshe dpag med/ spyan ras gzigs/ thod phreng rtsal bzhi/ rdo rje rigs bzhi/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ lha dang rig 'dzin/ drang srong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi khā hi/ yi dam gu ru drag khros kyi lha tshogs/ drag po khro rol phur bu'i lha tshogs/ theg pa rim dgur gtogs pa'i lha tshogs/ bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud/ dam can gter gyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi khā hi/
zhes bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i mtshan don sbyar ba'i rim pa rol pa rdo rjes bris//
